object.name: session_power_manager
object.description: Interface for querying and requesting system power operations. A client may only perform an operation when can_control is non-zero. The result of each operation is reported on this object with done or error.

s2c.name: can_control
s2c.description: Non-zero if this client can reboot, power off, suspend, or hibernate without first closing other users' sessions. This value is sent when the object is created and whenever the permission changes.

arg.name: can_control
arg.summary: non-zero if power operations are currently allowed

value.name: permission_denied
value.summary: power operation is not currently allowed

value.name: io
value.summary: power command failed or is not configured
